capability_gate: All 8 tasks completed; both side-to-move checks, both legal-move checks and at least 2 of 4 verified mate-in-one fixtures passed.
early_stop: Stop capability stage after 2 consecutive generation-limit or infrastructure failures. Report incomplete capability assessment, not inability to solve chess.
evaluation: Only if gate passes: 24 fresh puzzles, 4 per rating x one/multi-move cell; exclude all 198 original, reserved and first-move pilot IDs.
outcome: Assisted exact official first move; fresh independent request per puzzle; no full-sequence claim.
baseline: Exact uniform random legal-choice expectation and one-sided Poisson-binomial upper tail, one model only.
interpretation: Hosted assisted first-move feasibility study, not model comparison. Provider, model and generation settings differ from local runs. No classifier fitting on 24 puzzles.
output_format: Strict JSON schema with legal choices
